data.long_meaning: The meaning of Harod is recorded in name-lists as “Mountain of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harod expresses “Mountain of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harod total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
